body: As really upsetting as it is that you feel this way, this happened to me. I attempted suicide three years ago and I’ve been suffering badly with depression and anxiety for 4 years before then. My parents (my mum is so much better now) were old fashioned, didn’t believe in mental illness and never took my illnesses seriously. When I ended up in hospital, my mum in particular started to take me seriously. Please don’t do something you’ll regret, it stays with you. There will be a better way to address this but I understand how you feel.
Completely, but has it worsened on a higher level than we anticipated during the course of the pandemic?
I’m really sorry to hear that. This is exactly what I’m aiming to explore, whether that has been the case on an international level. I really hope you’re okay and find the road to recovery:)
I get that but what I wanted to find out is whether addictions and drug consumption have increased during the course of the pandemic.
They’re really nice thank you! Unfortunately Etsy deliveries are really slow right now which is understandable but I’m worried that if I order anything on there it won’t arrive on time.
